strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Pulogulaamu y'abatunzi abatambula ne van sales
strings.tierB.home.description: Eri abagabi: invoyisi ne lisiiti okuva ku ssimu, sitooka mu mmotoka, okusolooza ssente, amakubo n'emikyalo. Ekola awatali yintaneeti.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Ddukanya abatunzi bo abatambula okuva ku mukyalo ogusooka okutuuka ku ssente ezisembayo okusoloozebwa
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales nkola ya ku yintaneeti (cloud) eri kampuni ezigaba ebyamaguzi n'abasuubuzi abatunda mu bungi abalina abatunzi abatambula (sales reps). Abatunzi bafulumya era bakuba ku pulinta invoyisi ne lisiiti nga bakozesa essimu, bagoberera sitooka eri mu mmotoka era bawandiika emikyalo, ate bamaneja ne balaba amangu ddala ebitundiddwa, ssente ezisoloozeddwa n'amabanja ga bakasitoma.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Invoyisi okuva ku ssimu y'omutunzi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Omutunzi afulumya invoyisi ng'ali ku mulyango gwa kasitoma, n'agikuba ku pulinta ya Bluetooth ey'ebbugumu (thermal) nga tannava mu dduuka.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Okusolooza ssente n'amabanja ga bakasitoma
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Buli musasulo gufuna lisiiti erina ennamba, ekwataganyizibwa ne invoyisi ze gusasula, era ebbanja lya kasitoma ne lipooti y'akawunti ye bikyuka amangu ago.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Obuvunaanyizibwa ku sitooka y'emmotoka
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Sitooka ya buli mmotoka egobererwa ekintu ku kintu: ebyatikkiddwa, ebyatundiddwa, ebyazzibwayo n'ebisigaddewo, ekituli ne kirabikira ku lunaku olwo lwennyini.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Amakubo n'emikyalo
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Emikyalo giwandiikibwa n'ekifo, essaawa n'ebifaananyi, era ekkubo lya buli mutunzi liragibwa ku maapu eri maneja.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Ekola awatali yintaneeti
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Abatunzi beeyongera okutunda nga tewali netiweeka. Ebiwandiiko bisigala ku ssimu ne biweerezebwa byokka, awatali kuddibwamu, yintaneeti bw'ekomawo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Dashibodi ya ku mukutu eri bamaneja
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Ebitundiddwa, ssente ezisoloozeddwa, ebyazzibwayo, sitooka n'emirimu gy'abatunzi mu kifo kimu, n'obuyinza obw'enjawulo eri buli mukozesa.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Tubuulire engeri gy'otundamu
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Saba quotation oba tegeka olukiiko. Tutunuulira abatunzi bo, amakubo, ebyamaguzi n'ebyetaago byo ku invoyisi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Teekateeka kampuni yo
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Yingiza ebyamaguzi, emiwendo gyabyo, bakasitoma n'abatunzi, era oteeke mu nteekateeka (settings) ekika kya ssente n'omusolo eby'eggwanga lyo.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Sindika abatunzi ku makubo
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Abatunzi bateeka app ku Android oba iPhone, batikka emmotoka ne batandika okutunda, okukuba invoyisi ku pulinta n'okusolooza ssente.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Goberera olunaku nga bwe lugenda
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Dashibodi ya ku mukutu eraga ebitundiddwa, ssente ezisoloozeddwa, sitooka y'emmotoka n'emikyalo ng'abatunzi bakyali ku makubo.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales nkola ya ku yintaneeti (cloud) ey'okuddukanya abatunzi abatambula mu kampuni ezigaba ebyamaguzi n'abasuubuzi abatunda mu bungi. Ekwata van sales (okutundira mu mmotoka), route sales (okutunda ku makubo amategeke), pre-sales (okukwata oda nga tezinnatuusibwa) ne DSD (okutuusa ebyamaguzi butereevu ku dduuka). Abatunzi bafulumya invoyisi, bazikuba ku pulinta, basolooza ssente era bawandiika emikyalo nga bakozesa essimu, ate bamaneja ne bagoberera ebitundiddwa, ssente ezisoloozeddwa, sitooka y'emmotoka n'amabanja ga bakasitoma ku dashibodi ya ku mukutu.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Yee. App y'omutunzi yeeyongera okukola awatali yintaneeti: omutunzi afulumya era akuba ku pulinta invoyisi ne lisiiti, awandiika emikyalo era ayongeramu bakasitoma, byonna ne biweerezebwa byokka awatali kuddibwamu yintaneeti bw'ekomawo. Waliwo ekyenjawulo kimu mu Saudi Arabia: kampuni ezikozesa okugatta ne e-invoicing zeetaaga yintaneeti mu kaseera invoyisi oba ey'ebyazzibwayo lw'efulumizibwa.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales ekola ne kampuni ezigaba ebyamaguzi mu nsi zonna. Buli kampuni eteeka ekika kya ssente zaayo n'omusolo mu nteekateeka zaayo, era invoyisi, lisiiti ne lipooti bibikozesa. FieldSales erina ekitebe kyayo mu Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, era okutandika kukolebwa ku yintaneeti okuyita mu nkiiko, WhatsApp n'obuyambi obw'ewala.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales egatta ku nkola za gavumenti eza e-invoicing?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Tuwagira okugatta ku mutendera ogwokubiri n'omukutu Fatoora ogwa ZATCA. Kino kikwata ku kampuni eziri mu Saudi Arabia. Mu nsi endala, nga mw'otwalidde ne Uganda, FieldSales efulumya invoyisi mu ssente zo n'omusolo gwo, era okugatta ku nkola y'eggwanga eya e-invoicing kufunibwa ng'osabye, oluvannyuma lw'okwekenneenya naawe ebyetaagisa mu ggwanga eryo. Ebweru wa Saudi Arabia tetusuubiza nti invoyisi zijja kutuukana n'ebyetaago by'eggwanga lyonna.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: App ya FieldSales eri mu nnimi ki?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Endabika ya app ya FieldSales (interface) eri mu nnimi zino zokka: Oluwarabu, Olungereza, Olufalansa, Oluturuki n'Oluchayina. Teri mu Luganda. Abatunzi ne bamaneja basobola okukyusa olulimi lw'endabika, era invoyisi ezikubiddwa ku pulinta zisobola okubaako olulimi olwokubiri ku mabbali g'olulimi olukulu. Empapula z'omukutu mu nnimi endala, nga mw'otwalidde n'olupapula luno olw'Oluganda, nzivuunule ez'okumanyisa ebikwata ku FieldSales.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Saba quotation, tegeka olukiiko oba tuwandiikire ku WhatsApp. Tuyiga engeri abatunzi bo gye bakolamu, oluvannyuma ne tukuyamba okuyingiza ebyamaguzi, emiwendo gyabyo, bakasitoma n'abatunzi. Abatunzi bateeka app ku Android oba iPhone, ate bamaneja ne bakozesa dashibodi ya ku mukutu mu browser yonna. Ssimu za smartphone bye byuma byokka by'oyetaaga.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Endabika ya app ya FieldSales eri mu nnimi zino: Oluwarabu, Olungereza, Olufalansa, Oluturuki n'Oluchayina. Teri mu Luganda. Empapula mu nnimi endala zinnyonnyola FieldSales olw'okumanyisa bwokka.
strings.tierB.category.title: Van sales: pulogulaamu y'okutundira mu mmotoka | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Pulogulaamu ya van sales ne route sales: invoyisi ku ssimu ne pulinta, sitooka ya buli mmotoka, okusolooza ssente, emikyalo. Ekola awatali yintaneeti.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Pulogulaamu ya van sales (okutundira mu mmotoka) eri abagabi n'abasuubuzi abatunda mu bungi
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales ye pulogulaamu ya van sales eri kampuni ezirina abatunzi abatundira mu mmotoka ku makubo buli lunaku. Omutunzi atikka emmotoka, atunda ku buli dduuka, akuba invoyisi ku pulinta, asolooza ssente era awandiika ebyazzibwayo ng'akozesa app emu ku ssimu. Maneja alaba ebyatikkiddwa, ebyatundiddwa, ssente ezisoloozeddwa n'ebisigadde mu buli mmotoka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Pulogulaamu ya van sales kye ki?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Pulogulaamu ya van sales, era eyitibwa cash van oba route sales, eddukanya engeri y'okutunda omutunzi mw'atwalira ebyamaguzi mu mmotoka n'atunda, n'atuusa, n'afulumya invoyisi era n'asolooza ssente mu mukyalo gumu. Edda mu kifo ky'ebitabo bya invoyisi eby'empapula n'amasimu ag'akawungeezi. Ewandiika buli kutunda, buli musasulo na buli kintu ekizziddwayo ng'ekiwandiiko, sitooka ne ssente ne bikeberwa ku lunaku olwo lwennyini. Eri maneja, eddamu ebibuuzo bisatu buli kawungeezi: buli mutunzi yatunda ki, yasolooza ssente mmeka, era kiki ekikyali mu buli mmotoka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Olunaku lumu ku makubo
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Olunaku lutandika n'okutikka emmotoka okuva mu sitoowa, nga kiwandiikiddwa. Ku buli dduuka, omutunzi alonda kasitoma mu app, ayongeramu ebyamaguzi okuva ku lukalala oba barcode, afulumya invoyisi n'agikuba ku pulinta ey'ebbugumu. Omusasulo guwandiikibwa ne lisiiti, era ekintu kyonna ekizziddwayo kiwandiikibwa n'ensonga yaakyo. Ku nkomerero y'olunaku, ebisigadde mu mmotoka bizzibwayo mu sitoowa. Wakati w'emitendera egyo, maneja asobola okugoberera ebitundiddwa, ssente ezisoloozeddwa n'emikyalo gya buli mutunzi ku dashibodi ya ku mukutu, nga takubidde muntu yenna ssimu.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Ekoleddwa ebifo ebirina netiweeka entono
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Amakubo g'okugaba ebyamaguzi gayita mu bizimbe wansi w'ettaka, mu bitundu by'amakolero ne mu byalo ebirina netiweeka entono. App y'omutunzi eya FieldSales etereka bakasitoma, ebyamaguzi n'emiwendo gyabyo ku ssimu, omutunzi n'asobola okufulumya n'okukuba ku pulinta ebiwandiiko awatali yintaneeti. Buli kiwandiiko kirina ekisumuluzo kyakyo eky'enjawulo, kityo kituuka ku seeva omulundi gumu gwokka, ne bwe kiddibwamu okuweerezebwa emirundi egiwera. Kampuni za Saudi Arabia ezikozesa okugatta ne e-invoicing zeetaaga yintaneeti mu kaseera invoyisi n'ez'ebyazzibwayo lwe zifulumizibwa. Lisiiti, emikyalo ne bakasitoma abapya byo bikyakola awatali yintaneeti.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Okusolooza ssente n'obuvunaanyizibwa ku mmotoka
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Ssente ezitambula ku makubo zeetaaga okulondoolebwa nga sitooka. Buli musasulo gufuna lisiiti erina ennamba esobola okukwataganyizibwa ne invoyisi ze gusasula, era ebbanja lya kasitoma likyuka amangu ago. Sitooka y'emmotoka ebalibwa ku buli kintu: ebyatikkiddwa ng'oggyeko ebyatundiddwa, ng'oyongeddeko ebyazzibwayo n'enkyukakyuka eziwandiikiddwa, bamaneja ne basobola okugigeraageranya n'okubala ebintu ebiriwo ddala ng'omutunzi tannaddayo waka. Ebyazzibwayo bisobola okugabibwamu: ebya bulijjo, ebyonoonese oba eby'okuwaanyisa, era maneja y'asalawo obanga biddayo mu sitooka y'emmotoka etundibwa.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Ekoleddwa ku lw'ani?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales esaanira abagabi n'abasuubuzi abatunda mu bungi ebyamaguzi ebitundibwa amangu ng'emmere, ebyokunywa, ebintu eby'okwoza n'eby'okwerabirira, ne kampuni yonna erina abatunzi abakyalira amaduuka ku makubo. Ewagira van sales, oda za pre-sales ne DSD (okutuusa ebyamaguzi butereevu ku dduuka). Si ERP ejjuvu: egatta ku nkola yo ey'embalirira (accounting) oba ERP okuyita mu API. Bamaneja be basalawo buli mutunzi ky'akkirizibwa okukola, ng'okuwa discount, okutunda wansi w'omuwendo oguli ku lukalala oba okwongerako bakasitoma abapya.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Njawulo ki eri wakati wa van sales ne pre-sales?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Mu van sales, omutunzi atambula n'ebyamaguzi n'abituusa, n'afulumya invoyisi era n'asolooza ssente mu mukyalo gumu. Mu pre-sales, omutunzi akwata oda, sitoowa n'egituusa oluvannyuma. FieldSales ewagira enkola zombi, kampuni n'esobola okukozesa cash van ku makubo agamu n'okukwata oda ku malala. Mu nkola zombi, invoyisi, ssente ezisoloozeddwa n'amabanja ga bakasitoma biri mu nkola emu, era bamaneja babirabira mu lipooti ze zimu.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Sitooka y'emmotoka ngibalirira ntya ku nkomerero y'olunaku?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales eraga, ku buli kintu mu buli mmotoka, obungi obwatikkiddwa, obwatundiddwa, obwazzibwayo n'obusigaddewo. Geraageranya obusigaddewo n'okubala ebintu ebiriwo ddala, wandiika enjawulo ng'enkyukakyuka ewandiikiddwa, oluvannyuma ozzeyo ebisigadde mu sitoowa mu kikolwa kimu. Emmotoka etandika olunaku oluddako n'embalirira ennongoofu era emanyiddwa.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Omutunzi wa van sales yeetaaga byuma ki?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Ssimu ya smartphone, Android oba iPhone. Pulinta ya Bluetooth ey'ebbugumu si ya buwaze, naye eyamba omutunzi okuwa kasitoma invoyisi oba lisiiti ekubiddwa ku pulinta. FieldSales tetunda byuma era teyetaagisa kika kya pulinta kya njawulo. Bamaneja bakozesa dashibodi ya ku mukutu okuva mu browser ya kompyuta oba ssimu yonna.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales esobola okugatta ku nkola yaffe ey'embalirira?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Yee. FieldSales egaba API esobozesa enkola yo ey'embalirira (accounting) oba ERP okuwaanyisiganya ne pulatifomu bakasitoma, ebyamaguzi, invoyisi, lisiiti n'entambula za sitooka. Ttiimu yo oba omukugu w'okugatta enkola azimba enkolagana eyo ng'akozesa ebiwandiiko ebinnyonnyola API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales mu nsi: ssente, omusolo ne e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales ekola n'abagabi mu nsi zonna. Laba ekika kya ssente, omusolo n'embeera ya e-invoicing mu buli nsi mu ttaabulo emu.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales ekola ne kampuni ezigaba ebyamaguzi mu nsi zonna. Buli kampuni yeerondera eggwanga lyayo, ekika kya ssente n'omusolo mu nteekateeka zaayo, era invoyisi, lisiiti ne lipooti bigoberera ebyo. Okugatta ku nkola za gavumenti eza e-invoicing kukola mu Saudi Arabia yokka. Mu nsi endala zonna kufunibwa ng'osabye. Ttaabulo wansi eraga, ku buli nsi, ssente ezikozesebwa eyo, omusolo ogwa bulijjo ku kutunda oba VAT, n'obanga okugatta ku e-invoicing ya gavumenti kukola oba kufunibwa ng'osabye.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Tuwagira okugatta ku mutendera ogwokubiri n'omukutu Fatoora ogwa ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Ekika kya ssente n'omusolo biteekebwawo buli kampuni mu nteekateeka zaayo. Emiwendo gy'omusolo mu ttaabulo eno gya kulungamya kwokka era giyinza okukyuka; kebera amateeka agaliwo kati n'omuwabuzi wo ku by'omusolo. Akasittale (—) kategeeza nti tewali musolo gwa bulijjo oguwandiikiddwa ku ggwanga eryo.
strings.tierB.about.title: Ebikwata ku FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales ekola pulogulaamu za cloud eri kampuni ezigaba ebyamaguzi ezirina abatunzi abatambula. Yatandikibwawo mu 2026 mu Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (erinnya mu Luwarabu: فيلد سيلز) nkola ya cloud eri kampuni ezigaba ebyamaguzi n'abasuubuzi abatunda mu bungi abalina abatunzi abatambula. Kampuni yatandikibwawo mu 2026 era erina ekitebe mu Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Ekola ne kampuni mu nsi zonna, era ekika kya ssente n'omusolo eby'eggwanga lyonna biteekebwa mu nteekateeka za kampuni yennyini. Bakasitoma baffe ze kampuni ezitunda era ezituusa ebyamaguzi okuyita mu batunzi abali ku makubo: abagabi, abasuubuzi abatunda mu bungi n'abakola ebintu abalina emmotoka zaabwe ez'okutunda.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Tuzimba enkola emu egattiddwa ku mulimu gwonna ogw'oku makubo: invoyisi ezikubibwa ku pulinta okuva ku ssimu y'omutunzi, lisiiti n'amabanja ga bakasitoma, obuvunaanyizibwa ku sitooka y'emmotoka, amakubo n'emikyalo nga biriko ekifo n'ebifaananyi, ne dashibodi ya ku mukutu eri bamaneja. App y'omutunzi ekola ku Android ne iPhone era yeeyongera okukola awatali yintaneeti, n'eweereza ebiwandiiko yintaneeti bw'ekomawo. Kampuni zisobola okugatta FieldSales ku nkola zaazo ez'embalirira oba ERP okuyita mu API, ebiva ku makubo ne bitaddamu kuwandiikibwa omulundi ogwokubiri.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Tunnyonnyola pulogulaamu nga bw'eri. Tuwagira okugatta ku mutendera ogwokubiri n'omukutu Fatoora ogwa ZATCA. Okugatta ku nkola za gavumenti mu nsi endala kufunibwa ng'osabye. Endabika ya app eri mu nnimi zino: Oluwarabu, Olungereza, Olufalansa, Oluturuki n'Oluchayina. Teri mu Luganda. Okwogera naffe, saba quotation, tegeka olukiiko oba tuwandiikire ku WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Yogera ne FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Yogera ne ttiimu ya FieldSales: saba quotation, tegeka olukiiko oba tuwandiikire ku WhatsApp ku pulogulaamu ya van sales n'abatunzi abatambula.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Tubuulire engeri abatunzi bo gye batundamu leero n'ekyo ky'oyagala okukyusa. Saba quotation, tegeka olukiiko oba tuwandiikire ku WhatsApp, omu ku ttiimu yaffe ajja kukuddamu. Ku buyambi, bakasitoma abaliwo basobola okukozesa emikutu gye gimu. Kiyamba bw'otubuulira eggwanga lyo, omuwendo gw'abatunzi, n'obanga batundira mu mmotoka, bakwata oda, oba byombi.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Tegeka olukiiko ku yintaneeti ne ttiimu yaffe. Tujja kukulaga olunaku lw'omutunzi mu app ne dashibodi ya maneja, nga tukozesa ebyokulabirako ebiri okumpi n'ebyamaguzi byo n'amakubo go, era tuddemu ebibuuzo byo ku kutandika.
